responsibility: This generator emits insn-flags.h, which summarizes named instruction and expander availability as HAVE_* macros and declares the corresponding gen_* prototypes. It scans all named DEFINE_INSN and DEFINE_EXPAND patterns, preserves conditionally-unavailable patterns by generating inline dummy stubs when needed, computes operand counts for generator signatures, and provides the compile-time availability and generator declarations that optabs and target-expansion code use.
